SHOT: A three-quarter profile portrait, the ear nearest camera sharp and centred, hair tucked behind it, the earring legible in frame. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: the ear, the jaw, the cheek below the nose, the neck, the collarbone and the shoulder. A cropped beauty detail, NOT a portrait.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; they hang on a white STAINLESS STEEL card held in a hand: ignore the card, the hand and the ring on the finger. IMAGE 2 is our approved packshot of this exact piece: the authority on its size, proportions, metal colour and finish; the piece in this picture must match it exactly. IMAGE 3 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn in the earlobe: EXACTLY ONE earring in this ear, through a single piercing, never two earrings stacked on the same ear; any other jewellery in IMAGE 3 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A PAIR OF CHANNEL HUGGIES: each is a polished gold huggie shaped as an ELONGATED rounded oval, clearly TALLER than it is deep, like a stretched letter U closed at the top, with a hinged click closure; its flat front face carries a channel of THREE light aqua-blue square stones in a vertical line between two gold rails, with plain polished gold above and below them. Exactly three aqua square stones on each front; never clear, never round stones; the huggie is a tall narrow oval, never a perfect circle, never a wide chunky hoop; no drops.

SCALE TEST: Each huggie hugs the earlobe, about 15mm tall. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
